GIS & Remote Sensing

Land Survey, Subdivision & CAD-to-Google Earth Conversion

Have a land plot drawn in CAD and need to see it on a real map? I handled the full workflow myself: from field survey to a subdivided parcel plan that opens correctly in GIS and Google Earth.

What I did:

  • Surveyed an agricultural land plot in the field using GPS.
  • Drew the boundary and subdivided it into parcels in AutoCAD, with dimensions for each parcel.
  • Converted the drawing into GIS data in ArcGIS Pro using the correct coordinate system.
  • Calculated the area of every parcel and prepared a clear attribute table.
  • Exported the result to Google Earth so the parcels can be viewed on satellite imagery.

What you get in a project like this:

  • Accurate parcel boundaries in their real location
  • A clear area and dimensions table for every parcel
  • Files ready for CAD, GIS, and Google Earth (KML)

Tools: AutoCAD, ArcGIS Pro, Google Earth

Earthwork Volume Calculation & Cut/Fill Analysis – Civil 3D

How much soil needs to be excavated or filled to bring a site to its final level? This project answers that with a full quantity take-off in Civil 3D.

What you get in a project like this:

Land Use & Land Cover Change Detection – Alexandria, Egypt (2016–2026)

How much farmland has been lost to urban growth in your area of interest? This project answers that question with satellite data and clear, ready-to-use maps.

I analyzed ten years of land use change in Alexandria, Egypt, and turned the results into maps that are easy to read and easy to present to decision-makers, planners, or clients.

What you get in a project like this:

  • Land cover maps for two time periods (urban, agriculture, water, barren land)
  • A change map that shows exactly where land changed and what it changed into
  • Clean, professional map layouts ready for reports and presentations
  • Data prepared with a proper coordinate system (Egypt Red Belt) for use in GIS

A clear, professionally designed map of Fayoum Governorate in Egypt, showing its position among neighboring governorates, main cities, road network, Lake Qarun, the Nile, and protected areas.

What I did:

  • Prepared and organized the spatial data in ArcGIS Pro and set the coordinate system (WGS 1984 UTM Zone 36N).
  • Highlighted the governorate and its neighbors with a clean color scheme and a clear legend.
  • Added main cities, major roads, and water bodies as labeled layers.
  • Designed the full layout: inset locator map, coordinate grid, scale bar, north arrow, and legend.

What you get in a project like this:

  • A presentation-ready map for reports, studies, or planning documents
  • A clean layout that is easy to read and easy to edit
  • Any area, theme, or language you need (English / Arabic)

Cut & Fill Volume Estimation for Site Grading – Wadi Kharouba

How much earth needs to be removed or added to level a site? This project answers that question with a terrain-based analysis and a clear map that shows exactly where to cut and where to fill.

What I did:

  • Used elevation data (DEM) of the site in ArcGIS Pro.
  • Compared the existing terrain with a target grading level to calculate cut and fill volumes.
  • Produced a cut/fill map showing excavation and embankment zones.
  • Reported the estimated cut volume, fill volume, and the grading level used.

What you get in a project like this:

  • Clear cut and fill zones on a map
  • Estimated earthwork volumes for early planning and feasibility studies
  • Results ready to use in a report or presentation
